Package CommonComponents

Class CommonComponents

java.lang.Object
CommonComponents.CommonComponentsAbstract
CommonComponents.CommonComponents
public class CommonComponents extends CommonComponents.CommonComponentsAbstract
The CommonComponents class provides reusable UI components such as buttons, labels, and dialogs with consistent styling. It extends the CommonComponentsAbstract class and implements its abstract methods.
